name: Uptime Kuma
description: Self-hosted uptime monitoring with status pages and alerts. Create your admin account on the first visit.

connection.title: Set up Uptime Kuma
connection.description: Uptime Kuma ships with no default login — the first page you see creates the admin account.

outputs.label: Uptime Kuma
outputs.help: First visit prompts you to create the administrator account.

firstLogin.note: Do this immediately after deploy: until you create the admin, anyone who opens this URL can claim the instance. Monitors and history live in the uptime_kuma_data volume.
